subtitle: On-device writing studio
promotional_text: File a recipe, spark a draft on this phone, then rewrite it — tighten, expand, warmer, formal, shorter. Keep what you would send. No account, no Wi-Fi.
description: Quietforge is a private writing studio that lives on your phone. Build workshops around one craft, file recipes with a seed and a form, then spark a draft on-device and rewrite it. Draft stages, a hearth of kept pieces and a move log — all stored on your phone, with no account and no network calls.
app_review_notes: Offline writing studio with an on-device composer. Create workshops, file recipes (title + seed + form), tap Spark to compose a draft locally, apply rewrite moves, and grade what to keep. No sign-in, no network calls. Camera and photo library are optional and only used when attaching a mood picture to a recipe. Please load the starter workshops on first launch, open Spark, compose, then rewrite and grade a draft.
